source.note: Covers plan rows #209 (Kenney Mini Skate bench.glb) and #186 (Quaternius Bench on poly.pizza, blocked by its Cloudflare challenge). Candidates rendered in the lab: Mini Skate bench.glb (the plan's own; a chunky solid seat and backrest, green, little slat detail), Furniture Kit 2.0 bench / benchCushion (indoor chair-like benches, 0.68 m wide), the Graveyard Kit bench.glb (identical geometry to the Holiday Kit one), and the Holiday Kit bench.glb, used here: two seat slats and two backrest slats on splayed side frames, the classic slatted park bench of a Japanese koen or station street. City Kit Roads has no bench. Zip pinned by sha256 (read from the kit page, as for every Kenney entry). Scale: height 1.0 m (top of the backrest), chosen so the seat is real size: seat top surface at y = 0.45 m (underside 0.37 m), length 1.53 m (real 1.5-1.8 m), depth 0.87 m with the splayed feet. Seating a character: seat top y = 0.45 m, seat slats span z = -0.14 to +0.34 m (front edge +0.34 m; seat centre about z = +0.10 m) and x = -0.76 to +0.76 m; the front faces +Z, backrest at the back (-Z). Look (noon): slats painted vermilion (accent) over dark brown (iris) shade, the side frames cream (moon) over paper (sky) shade; slat threshold -0.15 so the long seat front edge, whose source normals are bent at its bevelled ends, stays lit instead of splitting mid-face. Faceted (smooth false), 160 tris. Static, no clips.
